cohort: The study included 64 pregnant patients who underwent laparoscopic removal of benign adnexal masses between October 2010 and January 2020.
finding: Single-port laparoscopy (SPL) for removal of benign adnexal masses during pregnancy offered superior cosmetic satisfaction compared to conventional laparoscopy (CL) without increased perioperative danger, economic burden, or adverse pregnancy and neonatal outcomes, though with a longer surgery duration.
